title: Predict an unseen view and transfer
instrumentLabel: Source-informed software instrument; no human session or learning outcome
instructions: Inspect the exact supplied observations and named target query. The target result is withheld.
The formulas and answer alternatives are public. Alternatives are hypotheses, not correctness labels.
Start a software prediction, select an answer and commit it, or explicitly skip. The service locks the response before any reveal.
Reveal result is a separate action. Wrong answers, skips and repeat reviews remain recorded.
The saved tour contains no predictions or reveals. Reloading or reviewing a case does not restore naive exposure.

formulas.point: q=(x,y,z,w); observed xyz=(cos(alpha)*x-sin(alpha)*w,y,z). Each query acts on the original q.
formulas.ball: Center=(0,0,0,cw), unknown R>=0. At w=s, delta=R^2-(s-cw)^2. delta>0: ball radius sqrt(delta); delta=0: point; delta<0: empty.

practice.label: Fixed worked practice — never scored
practice.explanation: At 0 degrees x=1; at 90 degrees -w=1, so w=-1. At am, (3/5)*1-(4/5)*(-1)=7/5; y=z=0. The two equal supports still determine x and w because the source queries differ.

facts: The two cards identify the same point P.
The source has four real coordinates and is unchanged between queries.

The hidden center cw and radius R are fixed. Point and empty are different outcomes.
